name: remove-stale-autopilot-resume-smoke-script
title: Remove the stale test:autopilot-resume-smoke npm script whose source was deleted in the Authority retirement cleanup
description: packages/main/package.json line 70 still defines test:autopilot-resume-smoke -> node dist/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.js, but the TypeScript source src/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.ts was deleted in commit 5d3d7bd686 (Complete Authority Server retirement cleanup). In any fresh worktree or clean build the dist file does not exist, so the script fails with a missing-file error; on stale checkouts it silently runs an outdated compiled artifact. The smoke tested checkpoint-ledger-backed resume projection against the retired Authority boundary, so the correct fix is removal, not repointing.
